stories.title: Hong Kong’s political, business elite pay final respects to Tung Chee-hwa

en.title: Hong Kong's political, business elite pay final respects to Tung Chee-hwa
en.summary: Hong Kong's political and business leaders attended a vigil for Tung Chee-hwa, the city's first chief executive. Beijing sent wreaths for his state funeral while members of the public signed condolence books at community centres.

en.title: EU urges US to reconsider visa denial sanctions against Palestinian UN delegation
en.summary: The European Union called on the United States to reconsider its decision to deny visas to a Palestinian delegation attending the UN General Assembly high-level meeting.

en.title: Lights illuminate ancient pagoda as elegant music meets Qin opera
en.summary: The Xi'an Symphony Orchestra performed an outdoor concert at Big Goose Pagoda, merging Western classical music with traditional Qin opera in a cultural fusion.

stories.title: Denmark cautiously optimistic over Trump’s Greenland deal

en.title: Denmark cautiously optimistic over Trump's Greenland deal
en.summary: Denmark expressed cautious optimism after President Trump announced a deal on Greenland that would strengthen US military presence while keeping the island under Danish control. Greenlandic leaders supported the agreement following months of US pressure.

en.title: Iranian sources: US said to be ready for talks with Iran
en.summary: Qatar and Pakistan, acting as mediators, have informed Iran that the United States is prepared to engage in negotiations and reach an agreement, according to an Iranian senior official.

en.title: Sichuan mudslide disaster: 5 people missing, rescue efforts ongoing
en.summary: A mudslide struck a tunnel near Shijia Gully in Sichuan province early on September 19, leaving five people missing, all workers on a local highway construction project. Search and rescue operations continue.

en.summary: A technology dialogue spanning the Taiwan Strait is gaining momentum in Beijing as autumn approaches.

en.summary: The 29th Beijing-Taiwan Science and Technology Forum focuses on how AI advancement drives industry fusion and digital transformation across the Taiwan Strait.

stories.title: Is China’s fabled Empress Dowager Huayang buried near an airport? A study says yes

en.title: Is China's fabled Empress Dowager Huayang buried near an airport? A study says yes
en.summary: Researchers report discovering a tomb believed to belong to Empress Dowager Huayang, adoptive grandmother of Qin Shi Huang who unified China over 2,200 years ago, located near a major city airport.

stories.title: Methanol-tainted Nigeria drink kills 48, 182 made ill: government

en.title: Methanol-tainted Nigeria drink kills 48, 182 made ill: government
en.summary: Nigeria's food and drug regulator reported that a locally brewed alcoholic mixture contaminated with methanol caused 48 deaths and sickened 182 people in the southwestern Ondo state. Methanol causes severe poisoning leading to organ failure and blindness.

stories.title: Focused ultrasound could be the next big cancer breakthrough for hard-to-treat tumours

en.title: Focused ultrasound could be the next big cancer breakthrough for hard-to-treat tumours
en.summary: Researchers are testing focused ultrasound technology as a potential treatment for pancreatic cancer and glioblastoma, with experts suggesting significant advances in treating these difficult cancers could emerge within years.

stories.title: Perfect Diary owner Yatsen doubles down on skincare, R&D after business overhaul

en.title: Perfect Diary owner Yatsen doubles down on skincare, R&D after business overhaul
en.summary: Yatsen Group, the Chinese beauty company behind Perfect Diary, plans to focus on expanding skincare products and increasing research and development spending after completing a business restructuring that included acquiring overseas brands.

stories.title: China’s crude imports are rising again. What will that mean for oil prices?

en.title: China's crude imports are rising again. What will that mean for oil prices?
en.summary: China is increasing crude oil imports after a period of reduced purchasing during regional tensions, which could affect global oil price stability. However, analysts predict China will not immediately return to pre-conflict import levels due to refinery margin pressures and substantial existing stockpiles.

stories.title: Tesla auditing Chinese suppliers ahead of Optimus roll-out: sources

en.title: Tesla auditing Chinese suppliers ahead of Optimus roll-out: sources
en.summary: Tesla is conducting audits of Chinese suppliers as it prepares to scale up production of its Optimus humanoid robot for global market launch later this year. Multiple Chinese component and parts manufacturers are undergoing these supplier evaluations.

stories.title: Will AI adoption shrink office space? Asia-Pacific firms are on the fence in survey

en.title: Will AI adoption shrink office space? Asia-Pacific firms are on the fence in survey
en.summary: A CBRE survey found that 19% of Asia-Pacific companies believe AI adoption will reduce their office space needs, while 56% remain neutral on the impact and 25% expect increased space requirements.
